<div class="wp-block-cover has-custom-content-position is-position-bottom-left is-style-fb-scrim fb-ctaband" style="min-height:420px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img width="1024" height="683" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-34" alt="A surfer paddling out at sunset" src="https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/v2-camp-sunset-1024x683.jpg" data-object-fit="cover" loading="lazy" decoding="async" srcset="https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/v2-camp-sunset-1024x683.jpg 1024w, https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/v2-camp-sunset-300x200.jpg 300w, https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/v2-camp-sunset-768x512.jpg 768w, https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/v2-camp-sunset-1536x1024.jpg 1536w, https://www.flagbeach.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/v2-camp-sunset.jpg 1600w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-100 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Ready when the wind is.</h2>
<p class="fb-lead wp-block-paragraph">Tell us your dates and your level. We’ll tell you what fits.</p>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button fb-cta"><a rel="noopener" target="_blank" class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://flagbeach.bloowatch.com/booking">Check dates</a></div>
<div class="wp-block-button fb-ghost"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://www.flagbeach.com/contact-us/">Ask us anything</a></div>
</div>
</div></div>
